chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) regarding the Words of God — Blessed and Exalted —
'Or do they envy the people for what God has given them of His grace?'
He said: 'We are the envied ones.'

key_terms.الْمَحْسُودُونَ: The envied ones — those who are objects of hasad (envy/malicious envy). In Islamic ethics, hasad is prohibited. Here the term dignifies the Imams as those chosen by God whose gifts provoke the envy of others.
key_terms.فَضْل: Grace, bounty, divine favor — the special gifts God bestows upon those He chooses, including knowledge, prophethood, imamate

ai.seo_question: Who are 'the envied people' mentioned in Quran 4:54 according to Imam al-Kazim?
ai.summary: In this hadith, Imam Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) — most likely Imam al-Kazim — interprets Quran 4:54 ('Or do they envy the people for what God has given them of His grace?') as referring to the Imams of the Ahl al-Bayt. The Imam declares with the pronoun 'We' that the Imams are 'the envied people' (al-mahsudun) who received divine grace in the form of knowledge, authority, and spiritual leadership. This hadith belongs to the broader Al-Kafi chapter establishing the Imams as the rightful holders of the command (wali al-amr) and the recipients of God's special favor, which the enemies of the Ahl al-Bayt envied.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> regarding the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High
[4:54] Or do they envy the people for what Allah has Given them of His Grace?
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘We<sup>asws</sup> are the envied people’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl from abu al-Hassan (a.s.) who has said the following about the words of Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High,
Or are they envious of the people whom Allah has granted of His bounties? ( 4:54 Holy Quran)
